references.text: Contains the list of curses written in the Book of the Law, as referred to in Deuteronomy 29:26
The Lord's anger burns against the people when they break the covenant and turn to other gods
Describes God's wrath as a burning fire, parallel to the Lord's anger toward the land
Warning of the Lord's anger when the covenant is broken and the people serve other gods
The Lord's anger burns against Jerusalem because of idolatry
All the curses in the book will come upon the land because they abandoned the Lord
The Lord's wrath and fury are poured out on the people, just as His anger was poured out on Jerusalem
The curse and oath written in the Law of Moses have been poured out on Israel because they sinned
The curses that will come upon Israel if they do not keep the covenant
